svg.title: UC realization and subroutine replacement
svg.desc: Above, the real environment interacts with parties running protocol pi and adversary A. The ideal environment interacts with forwarding parties and simulator S, with the parties and simulator connected to ideal functionality F. For every adversary there must be one simulator that works for all efficient environments. Below, the composition theorem permits replacing F with pi inside the same application rho, subject to the realization model.
svg.text: For every adversary A, a simulator S works for every environment Z.
The environment cannot distinguish these executions except with negligible advantage.
The application's security proof carries over under the same model assumptions.
